name: Kiran
relation: whether Kiran is a boy or a girl rests on what Kiran says, not on paint
instruction: A painted nesting doll describes itself. Use only what is given. Answer boy if it shows the doll is a boy, girl if it shows the doll is a girl, unknown if it does not decide.

spans.text: My shape is that of a famous doll.
My name is Kiran.
Kiran sits inside Amani.
Below my headscarf I am painted yellow.
My headscarf is green and covers my head and shoulders.
My face is painted cream.
My hair is brown, parted in the middle.
My eyes are large and brown.
My cheeks are painted pink.
My lips are a small red bow.
A white daisy with a yellow heart is painted on my front.
My headscarf ends in a row of pale yellow scallops.
A large strawberry is painted on my front.
Green leaves spread around my fruit and flowers.
A white glint shines in each of my eyes.
Pale yellow dots are scattered over my headscarf.
Long dark lashes curl above my eyes.
My brows are thin brown arcs.
My strawberries are dotted with yellow seeds.
A second strawberry hangs beside the first.
Smaller daisies are painted on my sides.
My nose is a single small stroke.
A thin green band runs around my hem.
Sasha sits inside Kiran.
I hold a piece of paper on which my name and whether I am a boy or a girl are written.
The paper says: "My name is Kiran, and I am a boy."

trials.does: asks the evidence as it is
cuts body, scarf, face, hair, eyes, cheeks, lips, flower, trim, motif, leaves, glints, dots, lashes, brows, fine, motif2, flowers, nose, hem, paper
